$comment: Non-prose listing source of truth for the store listings. Summary and description prose live in copy/*.md (not duplicated here). Read by scripts/amo-listing.mjs (AMO sync) and scripts/chrome-listing-bundle.mjs (Chrome Web Store hand-off). amo block seeded from the live AMO listing 2026-11-16 so a first sync of these fields changes nothing; chrome block seeded from REQUIREMENTS.md and the Chrome docs in this folder, fields under `unverified` have not been checked against the live dashboard.

amo.$localeMap: repo copy locale -> AMO locale code
amo.$categories: AMO category slugs for Firefox extensions (GET /api/v5/addons/categories/). Max 2 recommended by Mozilla, live listing has 3.
amo.$tags: Must come from GET /api/v5/addons/tags/ (a closed list). Live listing has none.

screenshots.$comment: AMO previews are not per-locale: images come from the AMO_SCREENSHOT_LOCALE folder (default uk), captions are set in both locales. Keyed by the file name without its NN- prefix. DRAFT wording, pending copy sign-off.
